visual_weight_analysis: The boat in the lower left quadrant is the primary subject with high contrast against the dark sky and crashing waves adding dynamism. The absence of human figures means the boat itself must carry the emotional weight, necessitating a crop that emphasizes its off-center yet balanced placement.
justification: Moving the x-position to 40% and y-position to 45% better anchors the boat while maintaining asymmetrical balance. This adjustment fulfills the dual-core rule by keeping the mathematical centroid in view but frames the emotional story of the isolated, contrasting boat.
